channel.title: Macro Monitor: Learning Centre
channel.description: A daily economics explainer and country spotlight, each a 10-minute read.

item.title: The Explainer: GDP: what it counts and what it misses
item.description: Gross domestic product is the most quoted number in economics. It is brilliant at what it was built to do, and silent on much of what makes life worth living.

item.title: Country Spotlight: Japan: the economy that lived the future first
item.description: Deflation, a shrinking population and enormous public debt were once seen as Japan's peculiar problems. Increasingly, they look like a preview of what other rich countries face.

item.title: The Explainer: How inflation is measured
item.description: Behind every headline inflation figure sits a basket of hundreds of items, thousands of price checks and a surprising number of judgement calls. Here is how it works.

item.title: Country Spotlight: Germany: the workshop of Europe at a crossroads
item.description: Europe's largest economy built its prosperity on cars, machines and cheap energy. Now all three pillars are being tested at once.
